ارجحنوا (form IVq)
# اِرْجَحَنُّوا (irjaḥannū) /ir.d͡ʒa.ħan.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
# اِرْجَحِنُّوا (irjaḥinnū) /ir.d͡ʒa.ħin.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْجَحَنَّ (irjaḥanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
